claim: We approve eighteen direct reuses, seven conditional reuses and five rejections. Every use must create a traceable derivative copy without modifying the ORION snapshot.
evidence: Elena Martín: ORION is closed, but several projects have asked whether its mappings and profiles may be reused. Reuse must not erase the original context.
Mireia Soler: We identified thirty potential mappings between ORION and current models. Eighteen are directly reusable, seven require adaptation and five must be rejected.
Lucía Navarro: The five rejected mappings combine authorship and affiliation roles in a way that is incompatible with LUMEN.
Andrés Beltrán: Two of the seven adaptable mappings could support organization catalogues, but they must retain the last validation date and must not imply current validity.
Diego Ramos: Individual profiles contain data from institutional sources with different conditions. I propose reusing only public identifiers, normalized names and links to public outputs.
Sergio Vidal: Every reuse must record sourceSnapshot, transformationRule, licence and validationDate. Consumers must not receive an extract without those metadata.
Elena Martín: What about project and funding mappings?
Mireia Soler: Nine are reusable by ARIADNA as query vocabulary, but not as current truth. Three call codes stopped being used in 2025.
Lucía Navarro: We can retain them as historical aliases when the interface explicitly distinguishes the period.
Andrés Beltrán: VERDANT will not reuse personal profiles; only public organizations and projects.
